name: Burkie's Surf School
summary: A surf school run by Alan Burke, a Barbadian surfer who competed in eight ISA World Surfing Games and has taught since 1993. Lessons run in small waves, usually under 3 ft, between Long Beach and Freights Bay on the south coast. Boards are chosen to suit each surfer, and booking is by email or WhatsApp.
standouts: Founded in 2002; Alan Burke has taught surfing since 1993
Alan Burke competed in 8 ISA World Surfing Games
Barbados National Champion 7 times and Long Board National Champion 10 times
President of the Barbados Surfing Association 1997 to 2002

trips.title: Private Lesson
trips.summary: A private surf lesson with Alan Burke for one or two surfers. Lessons run in small waves suited to your level, on beginner boards chosen for your height, weight and ability. You can book a single two-hour lesson or six hours spread over three days.
highlights: Boards matched to each surfer's height, weight and ability
Single 2 hour lesson or 6 hours over 3 days
